title: Identification of inflammation-related biomarkers and therapeutic targets for neurogenic bladder fibrosis via multi-omics analysis.
authors: Li, Qi; Lv, Lei; Zhang, Yanping; Wang, Junkui; Liu, Xingchen; Wang, Zhan; Zhang, Junjie; Zhang, Shengli; Wen, Yibo; Li, Luping; Fan, Yingzhong; Wen, Jianguo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学分析鉴定神经源性膀胱纤维化炎症相关生物标志物，虽含分子对接但核心为表达分析与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Inflammatory responses play a crucial role in the progression of pediatric neurogenic bladder (NB)-associated fibrosis; however, their specific contributions remain poorly understood. This study aimed to identify inflammation-related biomarkers for diagnosing NB fibrosis and to explore potential therapeutic drugs. The NB rat model was established by spinal nerve severing, followed by single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing of bladder tissues. Through integrated analysis-including differentially expressed genes (DEGs), inflammation-related genes (IRGs), WGCNA, and machine learning-we identified four diagnostic biomarkers: HIF-1alpha, IL-1beta, CD40, and IL10RA. Molecular biology experiments validated the elevated expression of these biomarkers in NB patients. Single-cell RNA sequencing further localized their overexpression to epithelial cells, interstitial cells, and T cells. Connectivity Map (cMAP) analysis identified the MEK inhibitor PD-0325901 as a potential anti-fibrotic agent, which was subsequently confirmed through in vivo and in vitro experiments. Molecular docking simulations demonstrated that PD-0325901 exerts its therapeutic effects by targeting HIF-1alpha. Collectively, our findings not only provide novel diagnostic biomarkers for NB fibrosis but also propose PD-0325901 as a promising candidate for the treatment of fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 炎症反应在儿童神经源性膀胱（NB）相关纤维化进展中发挥关键作用；然而，其具体贡献仍知之甚少。本研究旨在识别用于诊断NB纤维化的炎症相关生物标志物，并探索潜在的治疗药物。通过脊髓神经切断建立NB大鼠模型，随后对膀胱组织进行单细胞和批量RNA测序。通过整合分析——包括差异表达基因（DEGs）、炎症相关基因（IRGs）、WGCNA和机器学习——我们识别出四种诊断生物标志物：HIF-1alpha、IL-1beta、CD40和IL10RA。分子生物学实验验证了这些生物标志物在NB患者中的表达升高。单细胞RNA测序进一步将其过表达定位至上皮细胞、间质细胞和T细胞。连接图谱（cMAP）分析识别出MEK抑制剂PD-0325901作为潜在抗纤维化药物，随后通过体内和体外实验得到证实。分子对接模拟表明，PD-0325901通过靶向HIF-1alpha发挥其治疗作用。总体而言，我们的发现不仅为NB纤维化提供了新的诊断生物标志物，还提出PD-0325901作为治疗纤维化的有前景候选药物。
